top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 chain from proglucagon processing and the active truncated peptide (Holst), through receptor and organ-level biology (Drucker), to the chemistry of the active form (Mojsov) is mature and independently replicated, and outcome trials confirm the mechanism. A discovery-based citation fits these three names and stays on what is scientifically new. P002 substitutes Knudsen for Mojsov, which is defensible on documented contribution but shifts credit toward drug design; it ranks above no award because the achievement clearly merits a prize.
